text: Programming: Java, C#, Python, JavaScript, TypeScript. Backend and cloud: distributed systems, REST APIs, microservices, Spring Boot, ASP.NET Core, AWS, Azure. Data and messaging: SQL Server, MySQL, NoSQL, S3, Kafka, Azure Service Bus and Event Hubs, SQS and SNS. DevOps: Linux, CI/CD, Docker, CloudFormation, CDK, monitoring, metrics, alerting.
Developed backend services and diagnostic capabilities for Microsoft Purview Information Protection, supporting enterprise RMS, encryption, and sensitivity-labeling scenarios at production scale.

Engineered a secure cross-service integration between Substrate and Item Query data services, designing service contracts, identity and token-based authentication, authorization scopes, and control policies, while handling API schema and versioning, cross-tenant data access, retries, and failure scenarios for reliable production communication.

Contributed to recommendation and risk-intelligence data pipelines using Spark, PySpark, Hadoop, APIs, and distributed data processing. Used AI-assisted engineering extensively for implementation, debugging, log and incident analysis, testing, and technical investigation, validating AI-generated outputs through automated tests, telemetry, source verification, and engineering review.

Designed backend features for a service-decoupling initiative within AWS Elastic Container Service (ECS), improving service independence and supporting scalable cloud workloads. Built REST APIs to decouple two microservices from shared NoSQL data stores, enabling independent scaling, ownership, and schema evolution.

Implemented unit, integration, canary, and contract testing and shipped changes through automated CI/CD production pipelines. Improved production reliability and on-call operations through exception handling, metrics, alarms, and monitoring dashboards. Automated infrastructure deployment across two AWS regions using Ruby, CloudFormation, and internal deployment tooling.

Developed ASP.NET Core backend services and REST APIs for Tesla vehicle billing-management workflows. Implemented transactional data-access workflows with Entity Framework Core and SQL Server, applying ACID principles to maintain data consistency and reliability. Delivered end-to-end product improvements across Angular and TypeScript interfaces.

Master of Science in Business Statistics (STEM, GPA 3.82) from Washington University in St. Louis. Bachelor of Economics with a minor in Spanish (GPA 3.81, Honors) from Beijing Foreign Studies University.
